summary: The selected wizard intrinsic reaches a missing potion.c:make_slimed implementation. C sets the SLIMED timeout and prints “You are turning into slime.” on the zero-to-active transition; js/wizcmds.js currently constructs then discards that message and does not change the property. This accounts for the sole current mismatch at step 17. Port the whole make_slimed function and wire the existing wiz_intrinsic caller. The later timeout.c:slimed_to_death behavior remains a separate unresolved path.

source.branch: For the selected #wizintrinsic command, the menu selects SLIMED with a positive count. In this recording the old timeout is zero and the default count is 30, so wiz_intrinsic() calls make_slimed(30, "You are turning into slime."). make_slimed() overwrites the timeout while preserving non-timeout intrinsic bits; when the truth value changes it marks the status line dirty and prints the supplied message. Port the whole function: when the timeout is cleared it also removes any delayed SLIMED killer and clears the hero’s fake green-slime monster appearance when present. wiz_intrinsic() separately caps an extension when a SLIMED timeout is already active.
callers: Selected production route: nethack-c/upstream/src/cmd.c:1965-1966 registers wizintrinsic -> nethack-c/upstream/src/wizcmds.c:wiz_intrinsic() (1039-1043) -> make_slimed(newtimeout, buf). JavaScript route is js/cmd.js:runIntrinsicCommand (3520-3523) -> js/wizcmds.js:wiz_intrinsic() (425-429); replace that branch’s discarded message and note_unported gap with the ported helper call.

Whole-helper wiring inventory: existing JavaScript source branches in eat.c:cprefx (and its eatcorpse refusal), spell.c:spelleffects SPE_CURE_SICKNESS, do_wear.c:Amulet_on, pray.c:fix_worst_trouble, artifact.c:invoke_healing, wizcmds.c:wiz_intrinsic, timeout.c:burn_away_slime, polyself.c:newman, both polyself.c:polymon cleanup branches, and uhitm.c:gulpum must call potion.c:make_slimed where C calls it. Preserve each outer function’s separate incomplete status.

Direct C callers without the corresponding JavaScript source branch remain explicit outer gaps: timeout.c:stoned_dialogue, uhitm.c:mhitm_ad_drin, and uhitm.c:mhitm_ad_slim. stoned_dialogue is the direct timeout caller; done_timeout is not.
dependencies: potion.c:set_itimeout() is already implemented as js/potion.js:set_itimeout() (469-470); it overwrites only TIMEOUT bits.

The cure branch consumes end.c:find_delayed_killer(SLIMED) as end.c:dealloc_killer() input (potion.c:209-210); both are already implemented in js/end.js (1715-1721, 1746-1755). Preserve this return-valued dependency in the whole-function port.
The active transition calls pline() only when msg is non-null (potion.c:204-208); the existing JavaScript message path is ttyPline(). The selected caller supplies a message.

Source: nethack-c/upstream/src/wizcmds.c:1039-1043 constructs the transition message and calls make_slimed(newtimeout, buf). nethack-c/upstream/src/potion.c:194-218 defines the complete missing helper: set_itimeout, status-line update and optional message on a timeout transition, delayed-killer removal on cure, and removal of the disguised green-slime appearance. In js/wizcmds.js:425-429 the existing caller creates an equivalent message, discards it with void message, and does not set the property; js/potion.js has no make_slimed implementation. This is missing behavior, so the actionable unit is a whole-function file port, not a divergence fix.

The production dispatcher is present: nethack-c/upstream/src/cmd.c:1965-1966 registers wizintrinsic; js/cmd.js:3520-3523 invokes js/wizcmds.js:wiz_intrinsic. This debug command returns without spending a turn, so timeout.c:slimed_to_death (still noted unported at js/timeout.js:825-827) is a separate later defect and does not explain the current message/status mismatch. Other source call paths, including uhitm.c slime attacks, have separate behavior and are outside this assigned case.
